---
title: "In Search of the Modern Audience"
subtitle: "If there is no interest, where is the interest?"
author: "David Price"
date: "2026-06-30"
categories: [news, analysis, entertainment]
---

There exists on YouTube and other online outlets the question of the modern audience. There is the audience that Hollywood creators want - "sophisticated" people like them. But, does that audience exist? It is an important question for the executives writing checks for hundreds of millions of dollars to fund projects that might flop. Is an investment an investment if it earns no interest?  If there is no interest in the product, where is the interest for the investment? If there is no interest in the investment, where is the interest in the product? Where is the interest if there is no interest?
